collector_lookback_minutes.description: Default lookback window used by native Nautobot collectors.

max_ingest_batch_size.description: Maximum observations accepted by one atomic bulk-ingestion request.

retention_days.description: Delete observations older than this many days; zero disables retention.

sample_metric_days.description: Default number of daily sample observations created per metric by the sample data job.

sample_metric_source.description: Source label written to sample MetricValue records.
